negative_findings: Stentor 2026 KN-93 is non-specific; calcium/calmodulin pathway not uniquely reconstructed.
Stentor 2022 population smooth curve is compatible with heterogeneous individual step transitions.
Stentor 2026 preprint fractional response challenges earlier model predictions but is not independently replicated.
Physarum 2016 transfer requires longer cell fusion, and fusion is not vertical reproduction.
Physarum 2021 body network dynamics may express passive history without learned novel function.
Microbial anticipation can be an evolved fixed regulatory response rather than within-life plasticity.
